title: save_metadata_draft 的 clientSpecVersion 示例写死 18.6.0：智能体照抄旧版本号
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ② seat-found defect, from the objectstack-ai/cloud#5086 card thread (baseline finding 16: the agent writes clientSpecVersion 18.6.0 against a 19 server).
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2). Companion to objectstack-ai/cloud#5086, which fixes the cloud eval bench dropping the MCP `initialize` instructions.
Grading: area:ai · domain:server · Bug · p2 · size XS · reach: every agent that saves through the MCP authoring door and copies the example version.
Dedupe: searched `clientSpecVersion example`, `e.g. 18.6.0`: none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：保存元数据的工具说明里，版本号示例写死成 18.6.0。服务端已经是 19，智能体看不到服务端版本时就照抄这个示例，触发版本不符的提示。
- 做法：示例改成服务端自己的版本号，随版本自动变。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Evidence
At `origin/main` ce4d8c7d, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`:
- ~:206, the refusal text: "… in SemVer form (e.g. 18.6.0)."
- ~:353, the `clientSpecVersion` parameter description: "… (SemVer, e.g. 18.6.0)."
The server version is already in scope there (`SERVER_SPEC_VERSION`, used by `clientSpecVersionVerdict` ~:203).

## What to do
1. Build both strings from `SERVER_SPEC_VERSION` (e.g. "e.g. 19.0.0"), so the example is always the server's own version. No other change to the verdict logic.
2. Grep `packages/**` and `skills/**` for other hard-coded `18.6.0` examples in agent-facing text and fix them the same way (list them in the PR).
3. Test: the parameter description and the refusal contain `SERVER_SPEC_VERSION`, and no literal `18.6.0`.
4. Changeset (runtime patch).
